fixed.explanation: filterCookies treats host-only cookies as domain cookies by prefixing '.', and uses a plain startsWith for paths. I changed it to do an exact host match for host-only cookies and an RFC 6265 path match. I also fixed pathMatches in cookieStore, which appended '/' to the request path, so a /foo/ cookie matched /foo.

input.intent: Cookie filtering by URL in the browser context cookie store: domain matching (host-only vs domain cookies) and path matching (prefix must align at a '/' boundary, per RFC 6265) when returning cookies for given URLs.
input.symptom: Cookie URL matching wrongly returns host-only cookies for subdomains, /api cookies for /apiv2, and sends a /foo/ cookie to /foo.

history.analysis: filterCookies treats host-only cookies as domain cookies by prefixing '.', and uses a plain startsWith for paths.
